title: Edit on a matrix row opens the matrix page in edit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the pencil on matrix A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's row shows a pencil and a three-dot button at its right.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens with its grid already in edit.
  • Cancel and Save show above the grid.
